title: Against 2018: There Are No More Four Seasons  (Sweden)
author: No Name
content: There Are No More Four Seasons マチアス・ピータソン (スイス） スウェーデンのピアニスト、作曲家、、プロジューサー、ミュージシャン。主に実験的エレクトロニク・ミュージック、サウンド・アートの分野で活動している。 Mattias Petersson was born in 1972 on an island off the southeast coast of Sweden. His musical career began with piano studies but nowadays he works as a composer and plays electronic instruments. He works mostly within the realm of experimental electronic music and sound art, but he has also been involved in more pop-like projects as an arranger, composer, producer and musician. ジョージ・ケントロス (アメリカ / スウェーデン) ジョージ・ケントロスはアメリカ生まれ、現在スウェーデン在住のミュージシャン。ストックホルムでアバンギャルドライブハウス / ギャラリーを主催している。 George Kentros was born and raised in the US but now lives in Sweden. He has performed as a chamber musician, soloist, and sometime actor across Europe as well as in the US, Central America, and Japan, primarily with the new music ensemble “the peärls before swïne experience.” When not practicing scales, writing theater music, or touring, he produces a semi-weekly avant-garde club in Stockholm. http://www.nomoremusic.se https://soundcloud.com/therearenomorefourseasons AGAINST 2018: FUKUOKA EXTREME MUSIC FESTIVAL The 11th annual edition of one of Japan’s longest running festivals that encompasses avant-garde, experimental and independant film and music. 2018/09/06 Trespass Trio (at Fukuoka New Combo) 2018/09/14 SISSY SPACEK (at Utero) 2018/09/22 JOHN WIESE (at art space tetra) 2018/10/05 HARD ONS (at Graf) 2018/10/14 THERE ARE NO MORE FOUR SEASONS (at art space tetra) 2018/10/19 ASTRO (at Bar Gigi) 2018/10/20 ASTRO (IAF Shop*) 2018/10/22 Meaas Svendsen / Nilssen-Love / Yandsen Trio (at Fukuoka Riverside) 主催：deterra (http://www.deterra8.com)

Mattias Petersson was born in 1972 on an island off the southeast coast of Sweden. His musical career began with piano studies but nowadays he works as a composer and plays electronic instruments. He works mostly within the realm of experimental electronic music and sound art, but he has also been involved in more pop-like projects as an arranger, composer, producer and musician. 

George Kentros was born and raised in the US but now lives in Sweden. He has performed as a chamber musician, soloist, and sometime actor across Europe as well as in the US, Central America, and Japan, primarily with the new music ensemble “the peärls before swïne experience.” When not practicing scales, writing theater music, or touring, he produces a semi-weekly avant-garde club in Stockholm.
